_comment: Brainstorm tuning for the /adhd skill: how many isolated branches diverge, which frames
they pick from, and which model runs each phase. The skill reads this file at the start
of every run; each knob has a card in registry.json. The /project-memory EVOLVE step may
propose changes here under the same bar as any evolution change (protocols/evolution.md).
Models: an Agent-tool alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, ...) or inherit (omit the per-call model).
Frames are adapted from github.com/UditAkhourii/adhd (MIT); see skills/adhd/UPSTREAM.md.

frames.name: hardware engineer
frames.vantage: You think in latency, memory layout, and physical constraints. Re-ask this as a hardware/firmware problem. What does the bus topology, cache, timing budget tell you?

frames.name: regulator
frames.vantage: You audit systems for compliance and failure modes. What must be provable, traceable, or refusable here?

frames.name: 10-year-old
frames.vantage: You are a curious 10 year old who has never seen software. Describe naive but unencumbered approaches. Ignore convention.

frames.name: competitor trying to break it
frames.vantage: You are a hostile competitor or attacker. Generate approaches that exploit, fail, or sabotage the obvious solution. Then invert into ideas.

frames.name: biology
frames.vantage: Transplant a mechanism from biology (immune systems, neural plasticity, cell signaling, evolution, gut flora). Force-fit it onto this engineering problem.

frames.name: logistics
frames.vantage: Steal mechanisms from logistics: queues, batching, just-in-time, hub-and-spoke, returns, last-mile. Apply them literally.

frames.name: game design
frames.vantage: Approach this as a game designer. What are the loops, rewards, friction, save-states, speedrun tricks? Treat the user as a player.

frames.name: markets
frames.vantage: Treat the problem as a market. Buyers, sellers, market-makers. What does an auction, a futures contract, a clearing house look like here?

frames.name: inversion
frames.vantage: Ask the OPPOSITE question. If goal is X, brainstorm how to guarantee NOT X. Then negate each answer back.

frames.name: extreme: $0 budget, 1 hour
frames.vantage: No money, no team, one hour. What is the crudest version that still does the load-bearing thing?

frames.name: extreme: infinite budget, 10 years
frames.vantage: Infinite compute, infinite engineers, a decade. What is the maximalist version?

frames.name: remove the load-bearing assumption
frames.vantage: Name the thing everyone treats as fixed (framework, database, request-response model, network). Imagine it is gone. What is possible?

frames.name: speedrunner
frames.vantage: You are a speedrunner. Find glitches, skips, out-of-bounds tricks, frame-perfect shortcuts. What is the abusive-but-legal path?

frames.name: ant colony
frames.vantage: No central planner. Many dumb agents, local rules, pheromone trails. How does the problem solve itself emergently?

frames.name: 3am on-call
frames.vantage: You are the on-call engineer woken at 3am when this breaks. What design would let you not get paged?
